notes.title: LAUNCHING TOMORROW: It's almost time...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/05de6999b5e506c915ab4891cc13525b0259f3cd.png[/img]

[h3]We're very excited to say that The Plane Effect finally launches tomorrow, 23 September on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X![/h3]


The Plane Effect is a dystopian isometric adventure, following a lonely office worker as he attempts to return home in the face of impossible odds. Experience a remarkable journey expertly brought to life with gorgeous visuals, crafted and tailored by VFX experts.

Keep an eye out tomorrow for our launch-day live stream right here on Steam!

notes.title: Play The Plane Effect Demo June 16th 2021!
notes.content:
Hey all,

We're very excited to announce that you will be able to get your hands on The Plane Effect [b]June 16th 2021 as part of the Summer Steam Games Festival! [/b]

To add to the news, we wanted to show you our brand new trailer; illustrating the journey our protagonist, 'Solo' goes through in his pursuit to find his home, and reunite with his family.

[previewyoutube=cWPcCmZyXrw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's The Plane Effect About?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/02bedf26dfed89289c1d0b5805c846678782fd86.png[/img]
It's your final day at the office, it is time to clock out and return home - loomed over by a cosmic anomaly with an oppressive, otherworldly force. Helpless over the cosmos, all you know is that you must return to your family, as soon as you can.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/bf47dbb4d2a469f74e75759aec9df83c227e8624.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/f764d3c0a2d8ba3da9855248dca19f1332e25466.png[/img]
As you progress through the dystopic cityscape, you quickly you realise all is not as it should be. Did it always take this long? Were the streets always a labyrinth? Where even is "home"? All you know is that you must keep pushing ever onwards, you must keep going.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/23690c4c636a4c3385dfccd7abb9cec79e88bd60.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/06442fbdf27b1d45d4e52b4600b0134cd7370a55.png[/img]
Navigate beautifully and elaborately designed, otherworldly environments and solve unusual puzzles to keep Solo moving through each area. Players have the option to figure out puzzles step-by-step with no hints, or activate a little guidance on your impossible journey through 'Assisted-Mode'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/f2d08b1634aadd23fcad5e9438736fd3fe11dfed.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Plane Effect - Level Highlights
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/d2df1813a575b007112f4b747be3b6d26eced389.png[/img]

[h1]The Office[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/882fc0cabb87c3ed1ff239c8259146a48d10b146.gif[/img]

[b]The Office.[/b] A place Solo knows well. It's his home 9-5 Monday to Friday, and [i]sometimes[/i] on Saturdays too. Sat in front of his computer every day, with the cold glow of his screen illuminating his cosy cubicle.

But. [b]Today is his last day.[/b] He's finally free from the grind he was so[i] tired [/i]of... 


[h1]The Train Station[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/e189943a6cfe01e13f226127e664b1a38c9bf900.gif[/img]

The daily commute is something Solo had become all too familiar with. Taking the train to and from work. Those same old daily noises, the hum of the tracks as the train approaches. Finally it's time to go home. [b]For good.[/b]

[h1]Solo's Home[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/fdcfed228f0035c98f6d48dd9a61d5b25304a6cb.gif[/img]

A place where Solo relaxes day-to-day. Modern, sleek, it fit the aesthetic of today. [b]But somethings not right.[/b] [i]Something is missing... [/i]where was his family? 

[h3]What is happening? Something feels very different today. In the sky, above the clouds, a faint eerie glow... Is someone, [i]or something[/i] watching Solo?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39741292/7dfe701c2add63bbc9807a20262b8f2aaf73ee89.gif[/img]
